name: Michael is Home
source:
As his imaginary best friend, you have to help and entertain Michael, who has to stay home alone until the next day due to a snowstorm.

[translated from [url=https://gdejura.itch.io/michael-is-home]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一場暴風雪讓麥可不得不獨自在家待到第二天。你是他想像中最好的朋友，幫幫他的忙，陪他玩吧。

［譯自[url=https://gdejura.itch.io/michael-is-home]itch.io[/url]］
